Meanwhile two members of the coven tried to enlist Quinn in a hunt and offered him blood. He called their approach a betrayal of Isolde. [00:19:09–00:27:14]
Corv’s last word
At the Green Leaf, Milo told Vander he had meant to stop Halflin escaping. Vander urged him to learn to control his powers. Kaelith sent Barry to scout. The streets around the inn were quiet as most of the guards headed towards the farm. When Gerta announced a visitor under cover of housekeeping, Barry slipped through the front door and saw a hooded figure in a frost-covered coat. [00:27:25–00:39:08]
The visitor was Corv, with half his face already gone. He reached for Kaelith and vanished, leaving his robes and one final word: “Oblex.” Vander found a second vial sewn into the robes. It looked like Kaelith’s, and neither vial reacted. Kaelith took both and set out after Leon, convinced that Corv had named the missing ingredient. Vander and Milo followed on Luna, while Osric stayed at the inn to watch the guards. [00:39:43–00:47:07]
A signal and a flight to the caves
Leon told Isolde and Odettia he had an agreement with the creature and believed neither could live without the other. Overhead, the medic’s fireworks signalled for help. Odettia’s Suggestion barred magic against her and her allies, and the medic had found a way to call out while pinned beneath the griffon’s paw. Leon offered safety if they let him speak to his people. Odettia knocked him unconscious, hoping to gain time to find a way to separate them. Isolde carried Leon toward the coven’s seaside caves and gave the group an hour to come up with a plan. Odettia knocked out the medic too and brought him along. [00:54:15–01:06:43]
Vander and Milo rode around the marching soldiers and reached the farm as Odettia prepared to leave. Vander cleared up the garbled owl warning, then doubled back to collect Kaelith, who vaulted onto Luna at a run. Odettia and Quinn took the griffon, with Milo and the medic carried in its claws. Quinn felt the direction of Isolde through their blood bond and established a psychic link. Kaelith used Elementalism to hide the group’s trail. They stayed together and reached the firelit caves. Milo escaped the rough ride with a few cuts. [01:08:08–01:29:48]
The medic under the Zone of Truth
Odettia bound the medic as he woke and brought him before Isolde. She asked him to separate Leon and the oblex. Vander cast Zone of Truth through Luna, and the medic failed his save. He said Leon was the first person he had seen willingly make such an agreement. He suspected their souls had melded and was unsure what separation would do. [01:29:48–01:42:09; 01:53:46–01:55:53]
The medic admitted belonging to the Waterdeep Scientific Society. He said the WSS had two other oblex samples besides the one delivered to Saltmere. Their locations are unknown. His superiors saw a way to replace people for the benefit of Waterdeep’s ruling class. He identified the senior WSS member Aldric Mourne as Renard Holloway and said Holloway had left with the delivery ship. He also confirmed the strands in the dungeon came from Leon. The creature fed without leaving his body. [01:56:14–02:02:11]
The medic demanded safe passage off the island in exchange for more answers, and Odettia agreed. The WSS main laboratory is in Waterdeep. The medic described a specialised magical flame capable of killing an oblex, and warned that starving the creature might endanger Leon. He said the WSS had copied the Order of Aster key’s ability to suppress oblex replicas into other objects, some of which failed in transit. [02:11:23–02:13:16; 02:15:20–02:18:46]
Midnight
Leon woke in a panic and told the party that the oblex takes control at midnight. Dark wisps began to rise from him. The medic told Vander the key was around Leon’s neck. Vander cut him loose, and the medic ran. Leon warned that removing the key would make things worse. Odettia flew him to a patch of woodland away from town, set him down and withdrew. Kaelith sent Barry to watch. [02:23:13–02:36:16]
When the clocks struck twelve, the griffon landed, accepted Odettia’s thanks and flew away, fulfilling its bargain. Kaelith’s vial shook and pulled towards where Leon had been left. Quinn reached out through their psychic link and heard a voice almost like Leon’s. It cut him off. Through Barry’s eyes, Kaelith saw the figure straighten and look directly at the owl. Her link to Barry vanished. [02:36:17–02:41:54]
Kaelith cast Blur and started to retreat. A voice in the shadows told her, “Not you tonight, my darling,” and moved away. Odettia spotted an unidentified figure on the coast and sent Ariane to look. Vander mounted Luna to join her. Play paused before Ariane’s report. [02:42:29–02:46:43]
Where things stand

Leon was last seen in the woods, with the key still around his neck. The oblex has shown it can take control. The party has yet to find a way to separate them.
Kaelith is retreating with both vials and an ingredient lead. Her arm is still missing. Barry’s fate is unknown.
Odettia has roughly a day left for cleansing. The griffon has departed, and Ariane is investigating the coastal figure. [02:47:41–02:48:00]
The medic ran from the cave. His whereabouts and passage off the island remain open. Osric was last posted at the Green Leaf.

story-so-far.title: The Story So Far
story-so-far.content:
Daggerford and the wagon (Sessions 1–5)
The adventure began in Daggerford, a town reinforced by Waterdeep amid rising tension with Amn. The party took work escorting the wagon of the tiefling merchant Priya Nagorth. There are no recordings from these early days; see early-sessions for what the DM’s notes preserve, and the gallery for the map of Daggerford and the poster that started it.
Bearbarrow (Sessions 6–7)
On the road, Priya’s wagon stopped at the village of Bearbarrow. Something escaped from her cargo in the night: an oblex, an ooze that steals memories and wears people’s faces. It replaced the stable hand Julius. The party exposed the impostor to the constable, cleared the mine beneath the village, and found a strongbox marked WSS.
The road south (Sessions 8–10)
At a carnival the fortune-teller Zivra gave Odettia, Vander and Kaelith each a prophecy. The party fought a wyvern, and at an old watchtower Odettia’s family amulet, the Griffontack, woke. In eladrin ruins Kaelith found a crossing point toward her lost home, Cendriane. During a drake ambush, a thief made off with the WSS strongbox; the party guessed the WSS but never learned who. Afterwards Cassia briefed the party on the WSS.
Baldur’s Gate (Sessions 11–15)
In Baldur’s Gate they found Odettia’s face on a reward poster put up by her family’s steward, Theron Vale. They traced the WSS’s local operative, Aldric Mourne, to an Outer City building and a theatre, the Vellum Stage. There they rescued young Milo and overheard the name Holloway.
At an antiques house called the Closed Door, Vander learned the worst: his brother Sundar had sold the stolen Order of Aster key. The buyer’s agent called himself “Mourne”, and the key left west aboard a ship, the Tideworth. Someone signing only “M.D.” had written asking about it too, and was heading for Baldur’s Gate.
The party dodged the Black Boars gang hunting Odettia and laid a false trail. They freed Milo’s mother from a Guild debt, then sailed at dawn on Captain Neve Saren’s ship, the Maris, after the Tideworth.
The voyage (Sessions 16–22)
A storm nearly took Kaelith, whose body began to fade, and Neve went overboard and was rescued. Sahuagin raided the ship by night, leaving strange spiderweb coins. Someone burned the chart and fouled the compass. A stowaway, Quinn, was found in the hold.
The pirate Reza Sahil challenged the party to three contests, and they came away with a new chart and the greatsword Marianne. The coins led them to a drowned Waterdeep navy wreck, its dead crew, and a kraken spawn they barely escaped. At the dark Viledel lighthouse they destroyed a dread wight and a dread wraith and relit the beacon. Quinn looked into the lighthouse’s orb and has carried a curse ever since.
Saltmere (Sessions 23–32)
They reached Saltmere, a harbour town in the Moonshaes, just as its old governor was buried. His son Leon Thrace threw out the nobles, seated the commoners and declared a celebration.
While Odettia ran the funeral from inside, Quinn and Milo slipped into the manor. They found Leon’s old sickroom, with shackles on the bed, and a hidden stair down to a dungeon with fifteen chained prisoners. Vander and Kaelith destroyed a guardian construct in the harbour storehouse that the tunnel leads to.
The next day the party split up for jobs around town, and every thread pointed back in time:

a hunter who arrived decades ago and never left
a thirty-year order letting manor wagons pass the docks unchecked
harbour “wine” that was really blood
a governess murdered twelve years ago
the handmaiden Isolde, who vanished at the same time

At Harlan’s farm Vander destroyed the farmer’s risen corpse. Kaelith met Corv, a man fading out of time as she is. And Leon invited them to dinner.
Next they found a vampire coven living under Harlan’s farm, saved the Order of Aster knight Osric from it, and struck an uneasy truce.
At the governor’s table Leon asked them to destroy the coven, for 800 gp. That same night they learned the coven’s leader is Isolde, sister of Leon’s mother Celandine, and that she blames the manor for her sister’s death. See Session 27.
That night, Odettia’s Clairvoyance caught orders to burn the dead vampire before dawn and a description of how Voss had shut her into a shed. At the Green Leaf, an attempt to identify the overwhelming magic around Milo brought a possessive voice and burned Odettia’s hand. Milo called the presence his “dad”; the party could not identify it.
In the chapel’s medical room they found Sibbet, one of the coven, and Hobb, the man she was officially accused of draining. His shallow neck wounds and sulphurous residue, and her clean mouth, challenged the report. Quinn took Sibbet’s bracelet for Isolde.
Returning underground, they found Osric bound and gagged in a guards’ cart. A disguised Odettia got Vander aboard as another prisoner. The cart reached cells where about fifteen captives were connected to black, smoky tendrils running beneath a closed door. The party fought the guards. Kaelith burned through one strand, then nearly fell to crossbow bolts before Vander healed her. Play paused mid-fight. See Session 28.
In Session 29, Odettia’s fog covered the rescue while Kaelith’s Flaming Sphere burned through the strands. Vander and Quinn killed the two nearby guards; Quinn picked locks, Odettia melted three with phoenix fire, and Kaelith freed the elven twins. Eight prisoners escaped and four died, killed by the solidifying tendrils. Odettia recognised a Gundwynd shipping container being used to transport Osric.
Beyond the reinforced door, Captain Voss warned them away and sounded an alarm. Kaelith detected a mage using ice magic there, but the party never opened the door or recovered the cure ingredient. Odettia knocked Kaelith unconscious to force the retreat, and Vander carried her and Osric out on Luna while Odettia flew.
Outside town, Selûne rebuked Vander for freeing people who prey on the weak. Luna vanished and his weapon blessing failed, though learned spells remained available. The party reached Harlan’s deserted farmhouse, where Milo claimed to ward the front door. They settled down around dawn; Osric remained unconscious, the town was under alarm, and Vander intended to make amends.
After the rest, Kaelith’s left forearm vanished and did not return. Odettia’s Identify revealed Temporal Refuge unraveling and tearing her body apart, rather than sending her home. Vander removed Osric’s poison, waking him. Osric described Umber’s WSS-cloaked killers, the key’s reported suppression of oblex copies and Sundar’s attack on the surviving knights.
Quinn and Odettia met Isolde, giving her Sibbet’s bracelet and Celandine’s letter. She told them Celandine had been a vampire before marrying the old governor, blamed him for her sister’s death and identified him as the payer of the coven’s weekly blood. She willingly released Odettia’s bond, but the priest’s cleansing remained needed, and she expected a meeting with Leon at dusk.
Milo tested his ward with a pebble and blew apart the farmhouse entrance. Then the watchtower griffon answered Odettia’s call. She and Kaelith mounted it for a planned raid to seize Leon and return to the dungeon, while the others intended to approach by land. Play paused before the raid. See Session 30.
The raid and the meeting at dusk (Session 31)
Odettia and Kaelith carried out the raid. Odettia gave the griffon cold Dragon’s Breath, shattered the greenhouse and used Suggestion to stop the medic using magic against her allies. The griffon seized Leon and the medic while Kaelith burned the Lily of the Shade plants and became a ladybird. Odettia escaped to Harlan’s farm with both men.
Kaelith searched the manor alone. A ledger recorded “cuttings,” a receipt named a live specimen and accompanying specialist, and a medical chart described Leon as violent after midnight. Underground, the cells were scrubbed clean; restraint chairs and sulphur-smelling pipes led to Leon’s bedroom. Staff expected another prisoner transfer in two days. The vial was dormant, and the missing ingredient was absent.
Quinn sought help from Yara, who advised a specialist in soul magic and gave him temporary resistance aid. Vander, Osric and Milo entered town in disguise. A woman calling herself Julianne, who identified herself as Halflin’s sister, directed Vander to the rope works. His pursuit of Halflin ended in Milo’s explosive trap, which apparently killed the fugitive and destroyed the rear of the building. Luna and Vander’s blessing returned. Gerta sheltered the group at the Green Leaf, where Kaelith rejoined them.
At the farm, Leon admitted knowing his vampiric parentage, but did not explain his cure. He agreed to speak with Isolde. A large search force followed the griffon’s flight direction, while an owl warning intended to keep Odettia out of the dungeon instead made her fear her friends needed rescue there. Isolde arrived with her coven and exchanged a blood bond of mutual aid with Quinn. Play paused as they approached Leon, before the promised family conversation. See Session 31.
The cave and the stroke of midnight (Session 32)
Isolde confronted Leon about Celandine’s death. Leon admitted his agreement with the creature and defended the use of prisoners. At the Green Leaf, Corv vanished in front of Kaelith, leaving a second vial and an oblex clue. As the medic signalled the approaching troops, Odettia knocked out both captives. Isolde took Leon to the coven’s seaside caves and the party regrouped there.
Under Vander’s Zone of Truth, the medic identified the Waterdeep Scientific Society, its main laboratory in Waterdeep, and Renard Holloway as Aldric Mourne. He linked the dungeon strands to the oblex inside Leon. Leon warned that it took control at midnight, and Vander freed the medic after learning the key was still around Leon’s neck.
Odettia set Leon down in the woods. At midnight the griffon departed, the vial pulled toward Leon and an altered voice broke Quinn’s link. Kaelith lost her connection to Barry and began to retreat. Odettia sent Ariane to inspect an unidentified figure on the coast. See Session 32.
